en: Vintage monochrome postcard view of a cobblestoned market square with a central ornamental fountain surrounded by a metal fence and gas street lamps. Around the square stand several multi‑story historic buildings with gabled roofs and shopfronts at street level. A horse‑drawn carriage and a few pedestrians appear in the scene. The caption at the top reads in German about the market square and Bäckerstraße in Torgau, and several shop signs are visible on the façades.
